name: Lethal Fear
summary: Lethal Fear is a fan-made Gorilla Tag spin-off that takes the familiar fast-paced, tag-based gameplay and twists it into a heart-racing horror experience. In this game, players must not only use their agility to avoid being tagged, but also contend with an eerie atmosphere filled with lurking dangers and creepy, unpredictable threats.
